title: Binance hack drained wallets backing customer assets, reserve data shows
summary: Binance’s own reserve data lists the drained wallets as backing customer balances, leaving its ether backing an estimated 6% short until the exchange replaces what was stolen.

title: Binance loses over $6 billion in 'biggest crypto hack in history'
summary: Crypto prices are sliding on the news, with bitcoin falling back to $77,000, though Binance's co-CEO said it would cover all losses.

title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
summary: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
summary: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
summary: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.
